guidance: A card-making aid only. It copies the details you type, checks no phone number, meeting point or shut-off location, and is not an evacuation plan or a hazard assessment. Numbers, contacts and meeting points must be confirmed with your local emergency services and everyone in the household; keep the card current and follow official instructions during an emergency.
method: The card is assembled from eight text fields and a list of household members, with runs of whitespace and line breaks collapsed and every value length-limited: household 1-60 characters, emergency number 24, each meeting point 80, out-of-area contact name 60 and phone 32, shut-off notes 160, member name 60 and phone 32, at most ten members. A member line is split at its first comma into a name and an optional phone; a comma with nothing before it, a phone without a contact name, and any over-length value are rejected with a message that names the field. Gaps are reported rather than filled: a blank emergency number, no meeting point, no contact or member, and no shut-off notes each produce one warning on the card, which shows 'not set' in that position. The copy button puts the same card on the clipboard as plain text. Nothing is calculated beyond tidying the text, and nothing is stored, uploaded or fetched; the page makes no network call and keeps no state after the tab closes.
